intro: At Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Ajeck Rouack escalates his hunting trials. Having seen your early promise with young stalkers, he now sends you into the jungle to fell mature Stranglethorn Tigers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are learning, adventurer. Let us test your skills with the mature cats now. Kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers this time out.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you strive for greater challenges you must first prove yourself with the task at hand. Return to me after you've killed 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am impressed, adventurer. You are progressing quite well.
